profile.headline: Sr. AI Business Resource Specialist at McGuireWoods LLP
profile.geoLocationName: Rock Hill, South Carolina, United States
profile.summary:
Currently a Junior Software Developer at JELD-WEN, Inc., contributing to the delivery of high-quality technical solutions through collaboration with business and IT stakeholders. Responsibilities include software development, test execution, and creating project documentation while adhering to industry standards and best practices.  

I have a Master's in Computer Science at the University of North Carolina at Charlotte, complementing a Bachelor's in Computer Science. Skilled in software development, teamwork, and agile methodology, with experience in web development and customer service roles that have honed technical problem-solving and relationship-building abilities. Motivated by opportunities to create impactful technological solutions.

positions.title: Junior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Developed enterprise applications using Java, Microsoft Azure OpenAI, and CoPilot agents following the full SDLC from design through UAT and production support.
- Partnered with business stakeholders to gather requirements, create user stories in Azure DevOps, and deliver Agile solutions.
- Built AI-driven automation solutions to streamline business processes and reduce manual effort.
- Debugged, tested, reviewed code, managed Git version control, and supported UAT and production deployments.
- Mentored developers, led Agile sprint planning, and collaborated with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality software.
positions.insights: Skills: Mendix · Artificial Intelligence (AI) · Agile Methodologies · Website Building

positions.title: Web Development Intern
positions.description:
- Developed responsive, cross-browser web applications using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
- Designed and implemented intuitive user interfaces that improved website usability and user experience.
- Troubleshot and optimized front-end code to enhance application performance, functionality, and responsiveness.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
- Developed scalable software solutions in a distributed computing environment.
- Designed and implemented end-to-end software features based on technical requirements.
- Optimized algorithms to improve application performance and scalability.
- Collaborated in Agile teams to build, test, and deliver high-quality software.
